title: cross-functional-roadmap-sync-prep-sep-2026-personal-notes
content:
Prep notes for cross-functional roadmap alignment sync (Product + Eng + Applied ML) — meeting Sep 10 2026.

Goal: align on top priorities for H2 roadmap, confirm model onboarding timelines and infra capacity, agree on gating criteria for quality/regression, and surface major dependencies/risks so we can finalize commitments by next planning milestone.

Agenda (30-45m):
1) Quick status (3m): current top-3 product priorities + engineering capacity constraints.
2) Model onboarding timeline (8m): applied-ml to present candidate models + perf/latency profile. Need decision on which 2 models we commit to pilot in Dedicated test pool.
3) Infra/capacity ask (8m): platform-engineering to confirm Dedicated GPU pool availability and burst policy for pilot.
4) Quality gates & evals (8m): define prompt sets, metrics (perplexity not enough), regression thresholds, and rollback triggers.
5) Rollout & telemetry (6m): instrumentation, dashboards, SLOs, and cost tracking.
6) Action items & owners (2-3m).

Key notes / talking points to bring up:
- Product: prioritize use-cases that drive clear business metrics (search relevance rerank, customer support summarization, code completions). Which of these map to applied-ml model candidates?
- Applied ML: we need end-to-end perf numbers (p50/p95 latency, throughput with batching, quantized vs fp16) on Dedicated hardware — bring bench run IDs.
- Eng (serving/runtime): confirm that the KV cache behavior is stable for the expected prefix distribution; if not, we need a mitigation plan (smaller sequence windows, different caching TTL).
- Platform: verify autoscaling and burst limits for pilot accounts; if burst not available we must revise traffic shaping.

Open questions to resolve in sync:
- Can Applied ML shorten fine-tune timeline by 2 weeks if we reduce augmentation? (impact on quality?)
- Is there a cross-team preferred rollout policy? (canary % and duration)
- Does Dedicated pool have spare NVL/RTX capacity week of Oct 4?

Dependencies & risks:
- JIRA ML-1423: candidate model evals (blocking decision). Needs final run by Sep 24.
- JIRA ENG-987: KV cache fix for long-prefix stability (may change latency tail). Target merge by Sep 17.
- GH PR #87: new batching scheduler optimizations — needs review from infra by Sep 12 or pilot delayed.
- Confluence ROADMAP-2026: update after sync with final commitments.

Draft decisions I want to push for:
- Commit to 2 pilot models (one small/high-throughput, one higher-quality) and reserve capacity in Dedicated for 8 weeks starting Oct 4.
- Use canary rollout with 5% -> 25% over 48h, auto-rollback on latent regression >5% on quality metric.
- Instrument prompt-set-based quality monitors and tie alerts to the product slack channel.

Action items (from my prep & expected owners):
- Maya: consolidate final list of prompt sets and expected quality metrics; share by Sep 12.
- Evan Chen (Applied ML): produce bench report (latency, throughput, perf profile) for top 3 candidates; deliver by Sep 17.
- Ravi Kumar (Serving Runtime): triage ENG-987, share mitigation plan and ETA by Sep 14.
- Sophie Lee (Platform Eng): confirm Dedicated pool availability and burst policy by Sep 15; estimate cost delta for reserved capacity.
- Diego Martinez (Observability): draft dashboards (latency, tokens/cost, quality regression) and a playbook for alerts; initial version by Sep 20.

Notes to self (quick reminders):
- Ask Applied ML for exact bench run IDs and the dataset slices used (prod-like vs synthetic).
- Bring up potential need for extra dev support during pilot start week (tagging for on-call rotation).
- Prepare a 1-page decision doc to drop into Confluence immediately after the sync so Sales/CS can start planning.
- Double-check SLO wording with SRE: 'p95 latency < 300ms for small model under steady load' — is that realistic?

Post-meeting follow-up template (copy into Slack after meeting):
- Summary of decisions (models committed, pilot dates, rollout policy).
- Owners + due dates for action items.
- Links to artifacts (bench runs, PRs, JIRA) + next check-in date.

Tone: keep this light in the meeting, but be firm on dates — we need commitments to freeze scope for the pilot.

Misc: include quick links in the doc before sending: Confluence ROADMAP-2026, GH PR #87, JIRA ML-1423.

End of notes.
